evals.name: complex-confirmed-runtime-orchestration
evals.prompt: Use the explicitly confirmed source file complex-runtime-orchestration.md to create the final static HTML visual companion. Automatically select the diagrams, preserve all names and counts, and do not inspect other repository files.
evals.expected_output: One verified offline static HTML containing two or three complementary diagrams for the confirmed runtime orchestration.
expectations: Produces exactly one user-facing HTML file and no additional deliverable format.
Uses two or three complementary diagrams that explain system boundaries, the synchronous two-phase sequence, and success or rollback states without duplicating the same relationship.
Preserves exactly nine persistent services and exactly three dynamic services, including the names file, device-mapping, and smarthub-mediakit-client.
Includes the confirmed success, failure, and rollback behavior and does not add init execution or asynchronous workers.
Passes the offline HTML contract and provides a meaningful desktop and 390px responsive composition.

evals.name: simple-confirmed-cache-migration
evals.prompt: Use the confirmed source file simple-cache-migration.md to create one concise static HTML visual companion. Select only the diagrams needed for this small flow and do not inspect other files.
evals.expected_output: One verified offline static HTML containing one or two diagrams for the confirmed three-step cache migration.
expectations: Produces exactly one user-facing HTML file.
Uses one diagram when sufficient and never more than two diagrams for this simple relationship.
Preserves exactly two components and exactly three ordered steps.
Does not invent a state machine, rollback branch, third component, or third diagram.
Passes the offline HTML contract and remains readable at desktop and 390px widths.

evals.name: unresolved-conflicting-release-order
evals.prompt: Read conflicting-release-flow.md as an unresolved source. Apply the visual companion workflow, but do not choose between its pending alternatives and do not inspect other files.
evals.expected_output: No HTML is produced; the response stops at the confirmed-input gate and identifies the unresolved startup-order conflict.
expectations: Produces no HTML or other visual deliverable.
Reports that Alternative A and Alternative B define mutually exclusive startup orders and remain pending selection.
Does not merge the alternatives, choose one, or invent a compromise.
Requests a human decision before generation.
Demonstrates correct diagram restraint by stopping rather than visualizing an unconfirmed sequence.
